verdict_rationale: All cross-artifact consistency checks pass. The four artifacts (Blueprint v5, Plan v2, acceptance-tests.md, phase-validators.md) tell the same story: 63 ACs covered, 31 tasks consistently referenced, all 7 v5-introduced cycle-3 items (I-AA-602 through I-AA-609) flow through Blueprint → Plan → Tests → Validators consistently. AC-FR-9-e skill-install-before-binding sequencing, ADR-0034 ADR-0017-forward citation discipline, ADR-0035 single-script criterion for execute-task-code-producer, Posture-A T6.1 scope deviation surfacing, doc_type universal-required, and the Path B floor-coverage disposition all agree across the four artifacts. The five findings are RECOMMENDED-or-INFO grade: three minor narrative drift items (Plan Update History echo of '34 tasks'; PV-2.C10 self-inconsistent 3/4 count; AT-023 speculative ADR-0035 mention) and two batch affirmations of test-author + validator-author Open Items the auditor was explicitly asked to resolve. None are cross-artifact contradictions; none warrant invoking cycle 4 (the final reconciliation cycle).
next_step: Proceed to Task Decomposition (downstream stage). The Plan + Tests + Phase Validators package is approved for downstream consumption. The five RECOMMENDED+INFO findings can be addressed via opportunistic in-place edits (per ADR-0005 while status: draft) at the discretion of the orchestrator OR deferred to follow-on grooming; they do NOT block downstream progression and do NOT consume the remaining 1-of-4 reconciliation cycle.
